transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. I received a market-risk bulletin this morning that imposes new requirements on our cash-collateral reinvestments. It requires at least 60% of the full $20,000,000 cash-collateral pool — that's at least $12,000,000 — to be held in sovereign bills, and it limits exposure to any one sovereign-bill issuer to $7,000,000. The bulletin has not yet been entered in the desk's risk system, so it wouldn't show up in the normal pre-trade checks. This directly affects the preliminary plan to place the full $20,000,000 in a single 90-day bank deposit, since that plan would not meet the new sovereign-bill allocation requirement.
